Additional information
The directors have two options to acquire another machine in the coming year.
Option 1: buy a new machine
Option 2: buy two used machines
The cost of option 1 is $17 000 higher than the cost of option 2. In the first year of use, the
maximum capacity of each option is the same. The directors wish to select the option which will
maximise profit.
